name: The Assay of Record for Claim Two
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. Document B. Issued at C6. Lodged with Sump at E0, with A and D, for Document C. (Errata 247.)

LOOK_AT.say: The Assay of Record for Claim Two. Document B. It says my claim contains nothing, in a hand nobody in the territory can argue with.
repeat: 'Mud, rock, and a mineral recorded as disappointment.' She has signed it. It is the most authoritative thing anyone has ever said about me.
Worthless, certified. The form wanted an assay. It did not ask for a good one.
Nothing. It has been weighed and found wanting, and it is very calm about it.
